title: The tech products we enthusiastically recommend this holiday season
summary: We've been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets at TechCrunch this year, and we have some clear favorites to share for your Black Friday shopping and beyond.
llm_summary: TechCrunch’s editors have rounded up their top gadget picks from a year of hands‑on reviews, spotlighting the devices that delivered the best performance, design and value. From smartphones and smart‑home gear to laptops and wearables, these recommendations are meant to guide your Black Friday shopping and keep you equipped with the season’s most compelling tech.
